B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items with unlike fractional denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is not used to create matching unlike denominators.
Do not tag borrowing steps.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the common denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step subtracts fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when the subtraction occurs after common-denominator conversion.
Tag when the fraction part of mixed numbers is subtracted directly with matched denominators.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps that only find or create a common denominator.
Do not tag whole-number subtraction by itself.
Do not tag simplification-only steps after subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract mixed parts
skills.definition: Decompose mixed numbers or whole-number/mixed-number expressions into whole and fractional parts and subtract the parts separately when no borrowing is needed.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d to align with a mixed-number structure.
Tag when solution steps separately subtract whole parts and fraction parts.
Tag when the result is then combined from the whole and fractional parts without regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure-fraction subtraction with no whole-number part.
Do not tag cases where the key operation is borrowing/regrouping because the fractional subtraction is negative; use the borrowing skill as well.
Do not tag normalization of an improper fractional part inside a mixed number.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction and adjust the whole part when the fractional part of a mixed-number subtraction would otherwise be negative.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows or regroups 1 whole into d/d.
Tag when the whole part is reduced by 1 and the fractional part is increased by one whole denominator unit.
Tag in whole-minus-fraction, mixed-minus-fraction, or mixed-minus-mixed subtraction when fractional subtraction requires regrouping.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when whole and fraction parts subtract cleanly without regrouping.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.
Do not tag simplification after regrouped subtraction unless a separate simplification step occurs.

skills.name: Normalize improper mixed number
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number whose fractional part is improper as an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number like 2 3/2 or 1 5/3 is converted to a standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver explicitly states 'normalize' and rewrites the mixed number by carrying from the improper fraction part into the whole part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag conversion between equivalent fractions with the same value for denominator matching.
Do not tag borrowing during subtraction.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as n + 0/d.

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Reduce the subtraction result to lowest terms or convert a zero-fraction/whole-valued mixed result into its simplest final form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0/3 or 1 0/3 is simplified to 0 or 1.
Tag when the final answer is expressed in simplest acceptable form after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps that already produce a simplified result with no explicit simplification.
Do not tag combining whole and fraction parts unless simplification is also performed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/LCM/common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Apply in pure-fraction items or mixed-number items if unlike denominators are reconciled.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing steps that use the existing denominator to regroup a whole as denominator/denominator.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible form for subtraction, such as adding a 0-fraction part or converting an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when the rewrite is done to align whole and fraction parts for later subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions of fractions.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final combining of whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator and/or subtract the whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a solution separates a mixed-number subtraction into whole-part and fraction-part subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is first creating a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used because the fractional difference is negative.
Do not tag simplification of the result.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole into fractional units of the current denominator when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the subtrahend’s fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is rewritten as denominator/denominator and added to the fractional part.
Tag when borrowing resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag simple subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as x + 0/d before any need to borrow.
Do not tag simplification after the regrouped subtraction is completed.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction or mixed number to lowest terms, including recognizing when a zero fractional part yields a whole number or 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed number with 0 fractional part is simplified to a whole number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag unsimplified subtraction steps.
Do not tag merely writing the final answer if no reduction or whole-number simplification occurs.
Do not tag common-denominator conversions before subtraction.

skills.name: Compose final form
skills.definition: Combine the computed whole-number part and fractional part into the final mixed number, fraction, integer, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are recombined into one final quantity.
Tag when a result with whole part 0 is expressed as a fraction only.
Tag when a mixed-number computation is concluded by writing the combined final form.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag isolated subtraction of whole or fraction parts before recombination.
Do not tag simplification itself unless the step also explicitly combines parts into final form.
Do not tag pure-fraction items that end directly with the subtraction result and no recombination of parts.

C.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting when denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtraction.
Tag for mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts need denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag borrowing steps that use the existing denominator without finding a new common denominator.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number unless denominator matching is also performed.

skills.name: Normalize operand form
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or a mixed number with an improper fractional part into a subtraction-ready form with standard whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a zero fraction such as 3 + 0/5.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 becoming 3 1/2.
Tag when the rewrite is done to align the structure of the two quantities before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions between equivalent fractions.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when subtraction occurs after normalization or denominator alignment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is only to create a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps that adjust a negative fractional result.
Do not tag simplification-only steps with no subtraction.

skills.name: Borrow across whole
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units to resolve a negative or insufficient fractional part during subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-sized fractional units.
Tag when a negative fractional difference is corrected by reducing the whole part and increasing the fractional part.
Tag in whole-minus-fraction or mixed-number subtraction when regrouping is explicitly shown.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag simple subtraction when the fractional part is already nonnegative.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus zero fraction before any regrouping.
Do not tag simplification after borrowing is complete.

skills.name: Simplify result
skills.definition: Reduce the resulting fraction or mixed-number fractional part to lowest terms, including recognizing when the value is a whole number or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when a mixed number with zero fractional part is simplified to an integer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction steps that produce the unsimplified result.
Do not tag recombination into mixed-number form if no reduction or simplification occurs.
Do not tag normalization of operands before subtraction.

skills.name: Combine final form
skills.definition: Assemble the computed whole and fractional parts into the final mixed number, fraction, integer, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into one final number.
Tag when a result with whole part 0 is expressed as a proper fraction.
Tag when the final answer is stated after prior subtraction or borrowing steps.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction of whole or fractional parts by themselves.
Do not tag simplification-only steps unless they also explicitly combine parts into the final form.
Do not tag operand rewrites before subtraction.
